published.citation: Huber et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 221416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive: 5080 +/- 90 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..245H/abstract

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 221416 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
